ticketOpened.name: Helio · Ticket opened
ticketOpened.description: Fires when a service ticket is created (form, customer request or monitoring alert)

quoteAccepted.name: Helio · Quote accepted
quoteAccepted.description: Fires when a customer signs a sent quote

createTicket.name: Helio · Open a ticket from an alert
createTicket.description: Opens a service ticket on a monitored site from a monitoring alert (siteId, alert, severity, message); an alert already open on the site is not duplicated

assignOnCall.name: Helio · Assign the on-call technician
assignOnCall.description: Gives an unassigned ticket to the technician with the fewest open tickets

findManagers.name: Helio · Find the managers
findManagers.description: The dashboard users who manage Helio, for a notification

remindOverdue.name: Helio · Remind overdue invoices
remindOverdue.description: Sends every overdue invoice the next reminder of the settings schedule once it is late enough, and stamps the reminder on it
remindOverdue.minDaysOverdue: Days past the due date, without a schedule in the settings

planKickoff.name: Helio · Plan the kick-off
planKickoff.description: Adds a kick-off call to the project of a signed quote, or to its deal's next step

confirmInstallations.name: Helio · Confirm installation dates
confirmInstallations.description: E-mails the date, address and team lead to the customers of scheduled projects starting soon (once per project)
